code:

             over a quarter -- gradual, predictable
Peak event:  New Year's Eve, 10x normal volume, one night --
             sudden, temporary, foreseeable
caption: Both need planning, but very different kinds.

code:

| summarize AvgCU = avg(ConsumedCU) by bin(Timestamp, 7d)
| render timechart
caption: A single day's number says nothing about direction.
